# Industrias Figursa · full catalog



# Autoclaves

Vertical steam autoclaves for sterilizing labware, culture media, instruments and waste. Stainless-steel tank, cabinet and basket, a cast chrome-plated bronze lid, and three control levels: manual, automatic, and digital with timer.

## Features

- Working pressure up to 30 PSI
- Temperature up to 135 °C
- Safety valve and relief valve
- Dial pressure gauge and temperature indicator
- External water-level gauge
- Stainless-steel tank, cabinet and basket
- Cast, chrome-plated bronze lid

## Specifications

| Model | Control | Inner dimensions | Power |
|---|---|---|---|
| [AV-2550](https://figursa.com/en/products/autoclaves/av-2550/) | Manual, 3 heat settings | 25 × 50 cm | 1500 W |
| [AV-3060](https://figursa.com/en/products/autoclaves/av-3060/) | Manual, 3 heat settings | 30 × 60 cm | 2000 W |
| [AV-3560](https://figursa.com/en/products/autoclaves/av-3560/) | Manual, 3 heat settings | 35 × 60 cm | 2200 W |
| [AVA-2550](https://figursa.com/en/products/autoclaves/ava-2550/) | Automatic | 25 × 50 cm | 1500 W |
| [AVA-3060](https://figursa.com/en/products/autoclaves/ava-3060/) | Automatic | 30 × 60 cm | 2000 W |
| [AVAD-2550](https://figursa.com/en/products/autoclaves/avad-2550/) | Digital with timer | 25 × 50 cm | 1500 W |
| [AVAD-3060](https://figursa.com/en/products/autoclaves/avad-3060/) | Digital with timer | 30 × 60 cm | 2000 W |
| [AVAD-3560](https://figursa.com/en/products/autoclaves/avad-3560/) | Digital with timer | 35 × 60 cm | 2200 W |

## Applications

- Microbiology and teaching laboratories
- Clinics and hospitals
- Food and pharmaceutical quality control
- Sterilization of biological waste

## Frequently asked questions

**What is the difference between the AV, AVA and AVAD models?**
The AV series has manual control with three heat settings; the AVA regulates the cycle automatically; the AVAD adds digital control and a timer. All three share stainless-steel construction, 30 PSI and 135 °C.

**Which autoclave size do I need?**
The 25 × 50 cm chambers cover the daily use of a teaching laboratory; 30 × 60 and 35 × 60 cm suit culture media in volume and waste. Our team can help you size it.

**Do they include warranty and service?**
Every FIGURSA unit carries a one-year warranty from the purchase date, and maintenance and spare parts come directly from the factory.

One-year warranty against manufacturing defects, from the purchase date. +52 55 5871 5405 · figursa@prodigy.net.mx


# Laminar flow hoods

Horizontal and vertical laminar flow hoods that create a sterile work zone for preparing culture media, solutions and admixtures, aseptic filling and general microbiology. Stainless-steel interior, HEPA filtration, UV lamp and safety switch.

## Features

- HEPA filter, 99.97 % efficient at 0.3 µm
- Stainless-steel interior
- Low-noise blower, 2 speeds
- Interior lighting and UV lamp
- Safety switch

## Specifications

| Model | Flow | Approx. outer dimensions (W × D × H) |
|---|---|---|
| [CFH-60](https://figursa.com/en/products/laminar-flow-hoods/cfh-60/) | Horizontal | 67 × 80 × 200 cm |
| [CFV-60](https://figursa.com/en/products/laminar-flow-hoods/cfv-60/) | Vertical | 67 × 80 × 200 cm |
| [CFH-90](https://figursa.com/en/products/laminar-flow-hoods/cfh-90/) | Horizontal | 97 × 80 × 200 cm |
| [CFV-90](https://figursa.com/en/products/laminar-flow-hoods/cfv-90/) | Vertical | 97 × 80 × 200 cm |
| [CFH-120](https://figursa.com/en/products/laminar-flow-hoods/cfh-120/) | Horizontal | 127 × 80 × 200 cm |
| [CFV-120](https://figursa.com/en/products/laminar-flow-hoods/cfv-120/) | Vertical | 127 × 80 × 200 cm |
| [CFH-180](https://figursa.com/en/products/laminar-flow-hoods/cfh-180/) | Horizontal | 187 × 80 × 200 cm |
| [CFV-180](https://figursa.com/en/products/laminar-flow-hoods/cfv-180/) | Vertical | 187 × 80 × 200 cm |

We also build Type II laminar flow cabinets, class A and class B; specifications on request.

## Applications

- Culture media preparation and non-pathogenic inoculation
- IV admixtures, ophthalmic solutions and formulas
- Filling of sterile products
- Clinical laboratory, tissue work and sterility testing
- Electronic and optical assembly

## Frequently asked questions

**Horizontal or vertical flow?**
Horizontal flow protects the product and is common for media preparation and assembly; vertical flow reduces air directed at the operator and suits admixtures and inoculation.

**How often is the HEPA filter replaced?**
It depends on use and environment; we recommend checking airflow velocity and filter integrity at least once a year. FIGURSA provides the service and replacement filters.

One-year warranty against manufacturing defects, from the purchase date. +52 55 5871 5405 · figursa@prodigy.net.mx


# Climate chambers

Microprocessor-controlled temperature and humidity chambers for food studies, accelerated ageing, genetics, viral research, environmental science, biochemistry and growth studies. From 72 to 976 litres, with refrigerated versions and special sizes.

## Features

- Digital temperature control: ambient + 5 °C to 70 °C, ± 0.1 °C sensitivity
- Digital humidity control: 10 to 90 % RH
- T-304 stainless interior, magnetic seal
- Optional temperature and humidity recorder
- Optional computer interface and supervisory systems
- 120 V, 60 Hz power

## Applications

- Stability studies
- Accelerated ageing of materials

- Food and environmental research

## Frequently asked questions

**Do you build refrigerated chambers?**
Yes. Besides the CH series we build refrigerated and growth chambers such as the Germinador 388 (−5 to 55 °C). Tell us the range your protocol requires.

**What installation do they need?**
A distilled-water supply, a condensate drain and a 120 V, 60 Hz outlet.

# Kjeldahl apparatus

Digesters, distillers and combined units for protein and nitrogen determination by the Kjeldahl method, from 1 to 12 places, with reversible ceramic heaters for 500 or 800 mL flasks.

## Features

- Independent heating control per place
- T-304 stainless supports on an acid-resistant base
- Stainless distiller tubes welded to the condenser
- Motorized fume extraction on 6-place digesters
- Dial thermometer on the cooling-water outlet (6-place distillers)

# Crude fiber apparatus

A fast, safe and accurate condensate-reflux apparatus for crude fiber determination. The sample undergoes a simulated digestion: heated in acid, washed and heated in alkali to isolate cellulose and crude-fiber residue. A procedure listed by AOAC.

## Features

- 6 heaters with individual infinite-type temperature control
- Stainless-steel condensers
- 600 mL tall-form beakers
- Requires cooling water and drain
- 127 V, 60 Hz power

## Specifications

| Model | Places | Maximum power |
|---|---|---|
| [EFC-6000](https://figursa.com/en/products/crude-fiber-apparatus/efc-6000/) | 6 | 2100 W |

## Applications

- Crude fiber in feed and food
- Government and industrial laboratories
- Food-science teaching


One-year warranty against manufacturing defects, from the purchase date. +52 55 5871 5405 · figursa@prodigy.net.mx

# Water baths

Constant-temperature baths in T-304 stainless steel, from ambient to 60 °C without lid and up to 100 °C with lid, an electronic thermostat with 0.05 °C sensitivity and ± 0.1 °C accuracy. Digital control on every model.

## Features

- 0.05 °C sensitivity, ± 0.1 °C accuracy
- Low-density heater for long life
- Fibreglass insulation

# Laboratory furniture

We design furniture in 2D and 3D from your spaces and services (air, water, gas, power, steam, vacuum). Modules keep the same depth and height, so they can be relocated and extended without losing uniformity.

## Features

- Computer-aided design in 2D and 3D
- Modules fully reusable when the layout changes
- Connection to every service line
